subject.title: fix(signal): preserve newlines in debounced messages

question: Should this protected Signal delivery fix require a redacted live after-fix receive transcript or bridge/terminal log before it merges, or is the focused regression suite an acceptable exception?
rationale: The patch is narrowly correct in source, but the contributor reports no linked Signal account and therefore cannot show the changed behavior in a real transport setup; the protected label requires an owner to decide whether the normal proof gate may be waived.

options.title: Require redacted live Signal proof
options.body: Request an after-fix bridge log, terminal capture, or receive transcript showing two debounced messages arrive as distinct agent lines, with account details redacted.

options.title: Accept focused regression proof
options.body: Explicitly waive live proof if an owner judges the focused Signal context coverage and hosted checks sufficient for this isolated separator correction.

recommendation.title: Require redacted live Signal proof
recommendation.body: Request an after-fix bridge log, terminal capture, or receive transcript showing two debounced messages arrive as distinct agent lines, with account details redacted.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and its current implementation and evidence were supplied by that contributor.
